Web Proxies

  • Specialized tools setup between a browser/mobile application and a backend server.
  • Used to capture and view all the web requests sent between both backend and browser/mobile application.
  • Acts as a man-in-the-middle(MITM) tool.
  • Web Proxies can be used to capture HTTP requests and replay them.
  • Web Proxies work in the application layer unlike Wireshark which works in low-level for Network Sniffing and packet analysis.

Other uses of Web Proxies

  • Web application vulnerability scanning
  • Web fuzzing
  • Web crawling
  • Web application mapping
  • Web request analysis
  • Web configuration testing
  • Code reviews

Application of Web Proxies

  • Burpsuite

Burpsuite

  • Web Proxy tool(acting as an intermediary between a user's browser and a target server) for Web Penetration Testing.
  • Some of the paid-only features are:
    • Active web app scanner
    • Fast Burp Intruder
    • The ability to load certain Burp Extensions

Zap

  • Another Web Proxy(acting as an intermediary between a user's browser and a target server) tool developed by OWASP for Web Penetration Testing like Burpsuite.
  • Open source and free.
